name: Cafe Wall
description: Rows of dark tiles divided by thin mortar lines, each row stepped half a tile along, so the level courses seem to wedge apart.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color2), var(--color3)); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 @calc(round((max(0, (25 * (2 - abs(((@y - 1) % 4) - 2))) - 50)) * 100) / 100)%, transparent @calc(round((max(0, (25 * (2 - abs(((@y - 1) % 4) - 2))) - 50)) * 100) / 100)% @calc(round(((25 * (2 - abs(((@y - 1) % 4) - 2)))) * 100) / 100)%, #000 @calc(round(((25 * (2 - abs(((@y - 1) % 4) - 2)))) * 100) / 100)% @calc(round((min(100, (25 * (2 - abs(((@y - 1) % 4) - 2))) + 50)) * 100) / 100)%, transparent @calc(round((min(100, (25 * (2 - abs(((@y - 1) % 4) - 2))) + 50)) * 100) / 100)% 100%), linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 6%, #000 6%); mask: linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 @calc(round((max(0, (25 * (2 - abs(((@y - 1) % 4) - 2))) - 50)) * 100) / 100)%, transparent @calc(round((max(0, (25 * (2 - abs(((@y - 1) % 4) - 2))) - 50)) * 100) / 100)% @calc(round(((25 * (2 - abs(((@y - 1) % 4) - 2)))) * 100) / 100)%, #000 @calc(round(((25 * (2 - abs(((@y - 1) % 4) - 2)))) * 100) / 100)% @calc(round((min(100, (25 * (2 - abs(((@y - 1) % 4) - 2))) + 50)) * 100) / 100)%, transparent @calc(round((min(100, (25 * (2 - abs(((@y - 1) % 4) - 2))) + 50)) * 100) / 100)% 100%), linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 6%, #000 6%); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color1); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 6%, transparent 6%); mask: linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 6%, transparent 6%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
